name: Letterbox
summary: A newsletter signup whose Subscribe button folds into a plane and posts itself into a mailbox
about: An email signup card for a weekly newsletter. On a valid address the text flies into the button, the mailbox door opens, and the button shrinks, creases into a kite and becomes a paper plane that glides along an arc into the mailbox. The box thumps, the flag springs up, confetti flies and a thank-you note settles in. It suits newsletters, waitlists, blogs and coming-soon pages.
how: Hover: the envelope flap opens and the mailbox flag twitches. Type your email and press Subscribe or Enter.
An empty or broken address makes the field shake and shows a hint.
A valid address lifts out of the field into the button while the mailbox door swings open.
The button shrinks, folds into a kite, then a paper plane, and glides into the mailbox with little puffs.
The box thumps, the flag springs up, confetti flies and the thank-you note arrives. Use another email unfolds the button again.
